'''Rintel Aren''' was a [[Weequay]] [[Gender|male]] [[pilot]] who served as a [[Security guard|guard]] to the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. In [[4 ABY]], he was one of five guards assigned to accompany a trio of Jabba's prisoners on board a [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]] to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]], where the prisoners would be fed to a [[sarlacc]]. Upon reaching the pit, the prisoner [[Luke Skywalker]] used a [[Jedi]] [[mind trick]] to make Aren remove his [[iron]] manacles after the pilot and fellow guard [[Pagetti Rook]] selected Skywalker to be the first prisoner to be executed.

After Jabba ordered Rook to push Skywalker into the pit, the Jedi leapt back onto the [[skiff]] and attacked the guards with a [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|lightsaber]]. After the Jedi killed Rook, Aren became enraged and attacked him with an [[Axe|ax]], but Skywalker dodged the blow and struck the Weequay with the [[lightsaber]], sending him plunging into the sarlacc's [[Mouth|maw]].

==Biography==
===Jabba's finest===
The [[Weequay]] [[pilot]] Rintel Aren<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> was a seasoned warrior<ref name="Beware" /> who served for many [[Standard year|years]] as a [[Security guard|guard]] in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> he was selected as one of Jabba's fiercest guards<ref name="Beware" /> to accompany a trio of prisoners to their [[Death|execution]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]. The prisoners— the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and the [[smuggler]]s [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]]—were transported from the palace to the pit on a [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]] piloted by the [[Nikto]] [[Vedain]], which also carried Aren and fellow guards [[Pagetti Rook]], [[Velken Tezeri]], [[Kithaba]] and "Tamtel Skreej," the last of whom was in fact [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], a disguised ally of the prisoners.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Upon reaching its destination, the [[skiff]] carrying the prisoners came to a halt above the pit, which contained a [[sarlacc]] that the prisoners would be fed to.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Rook and Aren selected Skywalker as the first of the prisoners to be executed and pushed him toward the plank extended from the skiff's edge over the sarlacc. Skywalker used a [[mind trick]] to guide Aren into removing the [[iron]] manacles binding the Jedi's wrists before Rook pushed the prisoner again toward the plank.<ref name="Beware" />

===Sarlacc chow===
Jabba, who had traveled alongside the skiff on his [[sail barge]] ''[[Khetanna]]'' in order to view the executions, offered the prisoners a chance to beg for mercy before they were pushed in. Solo refused and Skywalker in turn offered Jabba a chance to free him and his allies or die. Amused, Jabba ordered that Skywalker be pushed to the edge of the plank, and then off into the pit. Rook used his [[BD-1 Cutter vibro-ax]] to force Skywalker off, but the Jedi caught the edge of the plank as he dropped and then sprang over Rook's head back onto the skiff. Aboard the sail barge, Skywalker's [[astromech droid]], [[R2-D2]], had launched [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|the Jedi's lightsaber]] into the air, which Skywalker caught upon landing and used to immediately attack Aren and his companions.

With no weapon in hand, the Weequay pilot ducked back away from Skywalker as the former prisoner knocked Kithaba and then Tezeri overboard.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Skywalker killed Rook before facing Aren, who expertly jabbed at the Jedi with an [[Axe|ax]]; however, Skywalker dodged the blow by stepping aside and spun around to deliver a fatal blow to Aren,<ref name="Beware" /> knocking the screaming Weequay overboard directly into the [[Mouth|maw]] of the sarlacc. Skywalker and his allies ultimately defeated Jabba's remaining guards and killed the Hutt, before destroying the ''Khetanna'' and escaping aboard the skiff.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Aren and the other Weequay who served Jabba were not among his smartest employees, but were fierce, dedicated and hardworking. Aren and Rook were amongst his fiercest guards, with Aren being the tougher looking of the two. Skywalker thought the pair could be siblings, although he was initially unsure of Aren's gender.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The death of Rook enraged Aren while he attacked Skywalker.<ref name="Beware" /> He had [[Color|brown]] skin, brown [[hair]], and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Equipment==
Aren used a cruel-looking ax while fighting Skywalker.<ref name="Beware" /> He wore a light brown jerkin with dark brown pants and black [[boot]]s. His outfit also included a brown belt with a [[holster]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rintel Aren first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="ROTJ" /> where he was portrayed by stuntman [[Julius LeFlore]].<ref name="Actor">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2014/09/behind-scenes-just-another-day-at-skiff.html|name=STAR WARS AFICIONADO WEBSITE|text=Behind the Scenes: Just Another Day at the Skiff!}}</ref> The character went unnamed for thirty-seven years until his name was revealed in "[[The Battle of Hoth and the Second Death Star]]," an issue of the [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] series published by [[De Agostini]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> on [[December 11]], [[2020]].<ref name="Altaya">{{Altaya|lang=fr|url=livres-bd/encyclopedie-star-wars|text=Official Star Wars Encyclopedia}}</ref> The issue erroneously describes him as being on the second skiff rather than the one carrying the prisoners. With the first letters swapped, Rintel Aren and Pagetti Rook [[Tuckerization|share their first names]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> with [[W:c:pirates:Pintel and Ragetti|Pintel and Ragetti]], a pirate duo from the ''[[Wikipedia:Pirates of the Caribbean (film series)|Pirates of the Caribbean]]'' franchise. The last names are based on the last names of their actors, [[W:c:pirates:Lee Arenberg|Lee Arenberg]] and [[W:c:pirates:Mackenzie Crook|Mackenzie Crook]].<ref name="POTC">''[[Wikipedia:Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl|Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl]]''</ref>

The [[2015]] adaptation of ''Return of the Jedi'', ''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' by [[Tom Angleberger]], differs from the film in its description of the battle above the sarlacc. It describes Pagetti Rook as the first guard Luke Skywalker knocked from the skiff, followed by a "rodent-like" guard and then Rintel Aren, who has been enraged by Rook's death. Aren is also described as crumpling to the deck upon his death.<ref name="Beware" /> The film does not show Rook's death, but he is still clearly visible and alive on the skiff when Kithaba and Velken Tezeri are knocked overboard. Aren is then knocked over the edge of the skiff by Skywalker. This article assumes that the film depicts the [[canon]]ical events,<ref name="ROTJ" /> while still treating Rook as dying prior to Aren in order to enrage the latter.<ref name="Beware" />
